errors.noSubscription: No subscriptions in the system or invalid plan.

appearance.title: Site appearance
appearance.note: Choose the accent palette (home, buttons, active links, etc.). Preview applies instantly; click Save for all visitors to see it.
appearance.preview: Preview: <accent>CS2 skins</accent> in the home title.

orange.label: Orange / gold
orange.description: Current theme. Warm and energetic, great for highlighting deals.

blue.label: Blue
blue.description: Aligned with the logo. Data and metrics focused.

visibility.title: Page visibility
visibility.note: Control which sections the public sees (visitors and non-admin users). Administrators always see them.

stats.title: Visits (tracking)
stats.note: Based on events sent from the browser (approx. one per tab per visit). Ranges use current UTC date.

bootstrap.title: First administrator
bootstrap.text: Set <code1>ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN</code1> in the backend environment and call <code2>POST /api/admin/bootstrap</code2> with the <code3>X-Admin-Bootstrap-Token</code3> header to create the first admin account (only if no admin exists yet).
